description: Sri Lanka Customs -   Rates of Exchange effective from 21.10.2019   to  27.10.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new exchange rates for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It is a regulatory instrument issued by the Director General of Customs exercising powers granted by law. The content focuses on legal/regulatory compliance requirements for international trade and customs payments, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
